decisions.reference: Unmodified original A_SpawnFly/A_SpawnSound compiled as host C. Spawn, sound, player lookup, immediate state action, teleport and removal boundaries are controlled; all 87 actor/timer/RNG/event slots match. Teleport explicitly verifies the post-state-action position and map rule.
scope: Every one of 256 random starts, all selection intervals, positive countdowns 1/2, sound/no-sound entry, player found/not found, immediate state position change
Fog consumes lastlook RNG before monster selection; monster consumes its own lastlook afterward
The original removes the cube after the teleport call even when teleport reports failure; native retirement defers the free to WorldSweep
256 random starts through real WorldSpawn, ActorTeleportMove and owned actor cleanup; expected monster types come from the independent original-C reference
26 actual world/state cases covering nonpositive countdown correction, missing/stale/deactivated targets, ownership and inactive/action guards
Sound callback exceptions/deactivation/retargeting; state callback exceptions/deactivation and position changes; published actors stay owned
Actual player search and immediate EnemyChase entry; map-specific monster telefrag including enemy death and dropped ammunition
Four ThinkersTick calls drive a reaction-2 cube through arrival and normal retirement; fresh-task heap returns to baseline
All ten original Freedoom 0.13.0 Phase 2 MAP30 marker trajectories at four random starts on actual WAD geometry
BrainSpit initial random tics plus canonical three-tic state intervals determine the exact arrival tic
Actual ActorMotion, ThinkersTick, BrainSpawn, teleport, floor/sector placement and retired cube removal; final RNG matches launch plus fog/selection/monster draws
This isolated trajectory fixture omits other map actors and ignores the spitter actor actions. It does not establish full-level gameplay or performance.

corrections: Nonpositive reaction counts complete instead of decrementing forever. BrainSpit already prevents them; explicit fixtures retain a safe contract for restored or externally edited state. Original failure witnesses are in spit-evidence.json.
Missing or retired generation targets retire the cube safely. After fog sound, the target is resolved again so callback deactivation/retargeting cannot silently use the old handle.
limitations: Normal thinker callbacks must defer actor reclamation until WorldSweep. Direct callback deletion of the currently executing actor is unsupported.
Full action dispatcher, persistent host, UI/audio, saves and progression are still unfinished. No catalog or playable-game qualification.
